AIC: Agreement Implementation Committee — continuing or established under clause 70.10.
Base rate of pay: The rate of pay payable to an Employee for ordinary hours of work, not including incentive-based payments, bonuses, loadings, allowances, overtime, penalty rates, or other separately identifiable amounts.
De facto partner: A person who, although not married to the Employee, lives with them in a relationship as a couple on a genuine domestic basis (whether the same sex or different sexes); includes a former de facto partner.
FFPPOA: First full pay period on or after.
Health and Allied Services Employee: An Employee classified in accordance with Part 1 of Schedule 2D and paid pursuant to Part 1 of Schedule 2B of this Agreement.
HSR: An Employee elected as Occupational Health and Safety Representative of a Designated Work Group under the OHS Act.
HWU: Health Workers Union — Health Services Union Victoria No. 1 Branch.
Immediate family: A spouse, former spouse, de facto partner, former de facto partner, child (including adopted, step and ex-nuptial), parent, grandparent, grandchild, or sibling of the Employee; and a child, parent, grandparent, grandchild, or sibling of a spouse or de facto partner of the Employee.
Manager and Administrative Worker: An Employee classified in accordance with the Manager and Administrative Worker classification structure in this Agreement.
Modern Award: The Health Professionals and Support Services Award 2020.
NES: National Employment Standards — Part 2-2 of the Fair Work Act 2009.
VHIA: Victorian Hospitals' Industrial Association — the employers' representative body.
WIRC Act: Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013 (Vic), or where applicable the Accident Compensation Act 1985 (Vic) or the Workers Compensation Act 1958 (Vic).
